head_coach.name: Lionel Scaloni
head_coach.play_style_summary: A highly versatile and liquid tactical system focusing on aggressive mid-to-high pressing, rapid three-second transitions, and a solid midfield engine (De Paul, Mac Allister, Enzo Fernández) that acts as a defensive shield and facilitates vertical progression, giving playmaker Lionel Messi creative freedom.

key_players.name: Julián Álvarez
key_players.performance_stats: An incredibly dynamic and mobile forward who achieved a landmark 20-goal campaign in all competitions with Atlético de Madrid during the 2025/26 season, setting a club record in the UEFA Champions League with 10 goals in a single season. Renowned for high-intensity pressing, defensive work-rate, and intelligent movement.

key_players.name: Enzo Fernández
key_players.performance_stats: A creative orchestrator in the engine room for Chelsea, boasting an exceptional 10 goals and 4 assists in the 2025/26 Premier League. Excels at progressive line-breaking passes, dictating match tempo with a high passing accuracy, and initiating high-press recoveries.

key_players.name: Lautaro Martínez
key_players.performance_stats: The clinical captain of Inter Milan, who netted 14 goals and delivered 4 assists in 25 matches during the 2025/26 Serie A campaign. Known for exceptional shot conversion rate, robust physical hold-up play, aerial threat, and leading defensive pressing structures.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Suffered a right soleus (calf) muscle injury during Argentina's World Cup training camp in Texas, ruling him out of the entire tournament.
Suspended for the World Cup opening match against Algeria due to a red card received in Argentina's final South American qualifier against Ecuador in September 2025.
Ruled out of the 2026 World Cup tournament due to injury.
